group.name: mybb_debugbar
group.title: MyBB Debug Bar Settings
group.description: Settings for the MyBB Debug Bar plugin.

enabled.title: Enable Debug Bar
enabled.description: Enable or disable the MyBB Debug Bar on all pages.

allowed_groups.title: Usergroups that can see the bar
allowed_groups.description: Select which usergroups can see the debug bar. Hold Ctrl/Cmd to select multiple. Leave all deselected to allow everyone.

show_queries.title: Show DB Query Count
show_queries.description: Display the number of database queries executed on the current page.

show_memory.title: Show Memory Usage
show_memory.description: Display PHP memory usage for the current page.

show_console.title: Show Console Tab
show_console.description: Show a Console tab that captures JavaScript console.log/warn/error calls and PHP debugbar_log() output.

show_debug.title: Show Debug Tab
show_debug.description: Enable the Debug tab that displays output from debugbar_debug() calls.

show_debug_always.title: Show Debug Tab Always
show_debug_always.description: When enabled, the Debug tab will always be shown in the panel. When disabled, it only appears when debugbar_debug() has been called.

log_to_db.title: Log errors to DB
log_to_db.description: When enabled, PHP errors captured by the debug bar will be logged to the database for later review.

drag_enabled.title: Enable Draggable Icon
drag_enabled.description: Allow the debug icon to be dragged and repositioned on the page. When disabled, the icon stays in its default position.

js_events.title: JS Event Auto-Capture
js_events.description: Auto-capture DOM events (click, mousemove, hover, touch, scroll, resize, keyboard, form, drag, animation/transition). Mousemove is throttled to every 500ms.

js_ajax.title: JS AJAX/Fetch Interception
js_ajax.description: Intercept XMLHttpRequest and fetch() calls to debug network requests and responses.

js_errors.title: JS Error Capture
js_errors.description: Capture JavaScript runtime errors and unhandled promise rejections.

js_performance.title: JS Performance Monitor
js_performance.description: Monitor memory usage (every 10s) and network connection info. Requires Chrome DevTools memory API.

debug_custom_code.title: Custom Debug Code (PHP)
debug_custom_code.description: Write PHP code here to execute debug calls without editing plugin files. Use debugbar_debug() function. Example: debugbar_debug('My Variable', $myvar, 'variable'); Put each statement on a new line ending with ;
